title: My data: online weather of a place
intro: With Online weather of my area the place is typed once; Find looks it up and fills the site boxes, and Get the weather reads the daily data of the chosen years from the internet. Only complete years up to last year are asked for.

marks.d: The choice that shows the place controls below.
A town, a village or a farm name.
Looks the place up and fills the latitude, longitude and elevation.
First year of the weather record to read.
Last complete year of the record; the current year is not available yet.
Reads the daily rain, temperatures, radiation and reference evapotranspiration and checks them before use.
Needed to work out radiation when it is not in the data; found automatically from the place name when possible.
